scope: Lossless UTF-8 packaging of original diagnostic compiler inputs and original test-source copies after their recorded runs. Original command paths and hashes remain historical observations. Restore raw_utf8 to the recorded filename before replaying a diagnostic; no replay or proof acceptance is inferred from packaging.

sources.raw_utf8: use std::{collections::{BTreeSet,BTreeMap},fs,path::Path};use serde_json::{Value,json};#[path="structural-comparator-with-aggregate.rs"]mod compare;fn main(){for name in std::env::args().skip(1){let old=compare::certificate("structural-boundary/previous-quoted-decimal",&name);let new=compare::certificate("verification-logs/domain-dependent-refresh/previous-pins/structural-boundary",&name);let regroup=old.name_table.iter().any(|n|n=="Mpk.CSharp.Ordinary.AggregateFold.Pipeline");let result=if regroup{compare::same_aggregate_scan(&old,&new)}else{let roots=old.declarations.iter().map(|d|old.name_table[d.name as usize].clone()).collect();compare::same_definition_closure(&old,&new,&roots).map(|_|())};println!("{}",json!({"file":name,"regroup":regroup,"old_declarations":old.declarations.len(),"retained_declarations":new.declarations.len(),"result":result.err()}));}}
